_comment: Merge the permission block below into your opencode.json. The agent is no longer defined here — it ships as agents/coach.md in this pack; copy that file to ~/.config/opencode/agents/coach.md and it carries its own permissions. These data directories sit outside the project worktree, so OpenCode treats them as external_directory (default: ask) and would otherwise prompt on every session read/write. A bare external_directory allow is enough on its own; edit and read already default to allow inside an allowed external directory, and the explicit entries below are only for clarity.
